# Blackline 0.15.146

* **Nothing stops a video any more.** Sending a message, a reaction arriving, a read mark — every
  one of them redrew the message and took the player with it. Whatever is running is left alone
  until it is finished.
* **Theatre keeps the conversation.** It used to cover the whole window, which is the wrong thing
  entirely in a chat: the reason to watch something here rather than in a browser is that the chat
  carries on beside it. The player is pinned over the top of the conversation now, at most a little
  over half its height, and the messages keep their own room underneath and still scroll.
* **Resizing a video keeps it in view.** Dragging it wider made it taller, and the bottom went under
  the bottom of the conversation, so you had to scroll after every drag to see what you had done.
  The conversation follows it down now, only as far as it has to.
